angle.hop-across-cut:
"""angle.hop-across-cut: exact checks.

Two fermionic modes in the Jordan-Wigner basis |n0 n1>, index n0 + 2 n1, with |10> = a0^dag|00>,
|01> = a1^dag|00>, |11> = a0^dag a1^dag|00>; a1 carries the string (-1)^{N0}. Matrices are 4 x 4 over Q.
(i) H = 7 N0 - 12 (a0^dag a1 + a1^dag a0) is symmetric, commutes with N0 + N1, is 0 on |00> and 7 on |11>, its
    one-particle block is [[7, -12], [-12, 0]] with eigenvectors (4, -3) at 16 and (3, 4) at -9; the four
    eigenvectors are a basis, so psi = 3/5|10> + 4/5|01> (norm 1) is the unique ground state.
    The generator is outside the supplied class: [N0, hop] = a0^dag a1 - a1^dag a0 != 0, while every supplied
    generator commutes with every N_x (Theorem singularity.class-relative-no-go-no-supplied).
(ii) psi is odd (Gamma psi = -psi), its state vanishes on the odd operators, the restriction to mode 0 is
    diag(16/25, 9/25) = Gibbs for N0 at q = 9/16, the restriction to mode 1 is diag(9/25, 16/25), and the left
    marginal is mixed (entangled across the cut).
(iii) psi is an eigenvector of N0 + N1 (eigenvalue 1) and not of N0 - N1.
"""
from fractions import Fraction as F

import GA
import fock
from tp_premise import premise

DIM = 4


def zero():
    return [[F(0)] * DIM for _ in range(DIM)]


def ident():
    m = zero()
    for i in range(DIM):
        m[i][i] = F(1)
    return m


mm = GA.mat_mul                         # dense matrix product


def madd(*ms):
    return [[sum(m[i][j] for m in ms) for j in range(DIM)] for i in range(DIM)]


def msc(c, a):
    return [[F(c) * a[i][j] for j in range(DIM)] for i in range(DIM)]


def tr(a):
    return [[a[j][i] for j in range(DIM)] for i in range(DIM)]


def mv(a, v):
    return [sum(a[i][k] * v[k] for k in range(DIM)) for i in range(DIM)]


def comm(a, b):
    return madd(mm(a, b), msc(-1, mm(b, a)))


def ann(j):
    """a_j in the Jordan-Wigner basis (index n0 + 2 n1), dense: lib/fock.py in LSB order."""
    return fock.to_dense(fock.ann(j, 2), DIM)


A0, A1 = ann(0), ann(1)
C0, C1 = tr(A0), tr(A1)
N0, N1 = mm(C0, A0), mm(C1, A1)
HOP = madd(mm(C0, A1), mm(C1, A0))
GAMMA = [[F((-1) ** bin(i).count("1")) if i == j else F(0) for j in range(DIM)] for i in range(DIM)]
K00, K10, K01, K11 = 0, 1, 2, 3
SUPPLIED = madd(msc(7, N0), msc(3, mm(N0, N1)), msc(-2, N1))


def ket(i):
    v = [F(0)] * DIM
    v[i] = F(1)
    return v


def expect(v, op):
    w = mv(op, v)
    return sum(v[i] * w[i] for i in range(DIM))


def generator():
    return madd(msc(7, N0), msc(-12, HOP))


def check_spectrum_and_unique_ground_state():
    H = generator()
    ok = H == tr(H) and comm(H, madd(N0, N1)) == zero()
    ok = ok and mv(H, ket(K00)) == [F(0)] * DIM and mv(H, ket(K11)) == [F(7) * x for x in ket(K11)]
    block = [[H[K10][K10], H[K10][K01]], [H[K01][K10], H[K01][K01]]]
    ok = ok and block == [[7, -12], [-12, 0]]
    ok = ok and block[0][0] + block[1][1] == 7 and block[0][0] * block[1][1] - block[0][1] * block[1][0] == -144
    psi = [F(0), F(3, 5), F(4, 5), F(0)]
    up = [F(0), F(4), F(-3), F(0)]
    ok = ok and sum(x * x for x in psi) == 1
    ok = ok and mv(H, psi) == [F(-9) * x for x in psi] and mv(H, up) == [F(16) * x for x in up]
    # the four eigenvectors form a basis; all other eigenvalues (0, 7, 16) exceed -9
    ok = ok and GA.field_rank([ket(K00), ket(K11), psi, up]) == 4
    ok = ok and min(F(0), F(7), F(16)) > F(-9)
    _tp_rv = (ok); assert _tp_rv is not False, "check_spectrum_and_unique_ground_state"; return _tp_rv


def check_generator_outside_supplied_class():
    premise("singularity.class-relative-no-go-no-supplied")
    c = comm(N0, HOP)
    ok = c == madd(mm(C0, A1), msc(-1, mm(C1, A0))) and c != zero()
    # hand values: [N0, hop] |01> = |10> and [N0, hop] |10> = -|01>
    ok = ok and c[K10][K01] == 1 and c[K01][K10] == -1
    # a supplied (number-polynomial) generator commutes with every N_x; H does not
    ok = ok and comm(SUPPLIED, N0) == zero() and comm(SUPPLIED, N1) == zero()
    ok = ok and comm(generator(), N1)[K10][K01] == -12
    _tp_rv = (ok); assert _tp_rv is not False, "check_generator_outside_supplied_class"; return _tp_rv


def check_parity_and_marginals():
    psi = [F(0), F(3, 5), F(4, 5), F(0)]
    ok = mv(GAMMA, psi) == [-x for x in psi]
    for op in (A0, A1, C0, C1, mm(A0, N1), mm(C1, N0)):
        ok = ok and expect(psi, op) == 0
    # restriction to mode 0: diag(<1 - N0>, <N0>), off-diagonal <a0> = 0
    left = (1 - expect(psi, N0), expect(psi, N0))
    right = (1 - expect(psi, N1), expect(psi, N1))
    ok = ok and left == (F(16, 25), F(9, 25)) and right == (F(9, 25), F(16, 25))
    q = F(9, 16)
    ok = ok and left == (1 / (1 + q), q / (1 + q))
    # mixed marginal: not a rank-one idempotent
    ok = ok and left[0] * left[1] != 0
    _tp_rv = (ok); assert _tp_rv is not False, "check_parity_and_marginals"; return _tp_rv


def check_boost_eigenvector_statements():
    psi = [F(0), F(3, 5), F(4, 5), F(0)]
    ok = mv(madd(N0, N1), psi) == psi
    d = mv(madd(N0, msc(-1, N1)), psi)
    # (N0 - N1) psi = 3/5|10> - 4/5|01> is not a multiple of psi
    ok = ok and d == [F(0), F(3, 5), F(-4, 5), F(0)]
    ok = ok and GA.field_rank([psi, d]) == 2
    _tp_rv = (ok); assert _tp_rv is not False, "check_boost_eigenvector_statements"; return _tp_rv
angle.hop-sea-filled-pairing:
"""angle.hop-sea-filled-pairing: exact checks.

Two fermionic modes in the Jordan-Wigner basis |n0 n1>, index n0 + 2 n1, |11> = a0^dag a1^dag |00>, as in the
check of angle.hop-across-cut, whose psi = 3/5|10> + 4/5|01> and H = 7 N0 - 12 (a0^dag a1 + a1^dag a0) are used.
V = (a1 + a1^dag) Gamma_0, Gamma_0 = (-1)^{N0}.
- V is symmetric and orthogonal (unitary and Hermitian), V^2 = 1; V a0 V = a0, V a1 V = a1^dag,
  V a1^dag V = a1, V a0^dag V = a0^dag.
(i) V psi = 4/5|00> + 3/5|11>, even, with left marginal diag(16/25, 9/25).
(ii) V H V^{-1} = 7 N0 - 12 (a0^dag a1^dag + a1 a0) entry by entry; the same eigenvalues 0, 7, 16, -9 on the
    image eigenbasis, so V psi is its unique ground state.
(iii) V (N0 + N1 - 1) V^{-1} = N0 - N1.
"""
from fractions import Fraction as F

import GA
import fock
from tp_premise import premise

DIM = 4


def zero():
    return [[F(0)] * DIM for _ in range(DIM)]


def ident():
    m = zero()
    for i in range(DIM):
        m[i][i] = F(1)
    return m


mm = GA.mat_mul                         # dense matrix product


def madd(*ms):
    return [[sum(m[i][j] for m in ms) for j in range(DIM)] for i in range(DIM)]


def msc(c, a):
    return [[F(c) * a[i][j] for j in range(DIM)] for i in range(DIM)]


def tr(a):
    return [[a[j][i] for j in range(DIM)] for i in range(DIM)]


def mv(a, v):
    return [sum(a[i][k] * v[k] for k in range(DIM)) for i in range(DIM)]


def ann(j):
    """a_j in the Jordan-Wigner basis (index n0 + 2 n1), dense: lib/fock.py in LSB order."""
    return fock.to_dense(fock.ann(j, 2), DIM)


A0, A1 = ann(0), ann(1)
C0, C1 = tr(A0), tr(A1)
N0, N1 = mm(C0, A0), mm(C1, A1)
G0 = madd(ident(), msc(-2, N0))
V = mm(madd(A1, C1), G0)
H = madd(msc(7, N0), msc(-12, madd(mm(C0, A1), mm(C1, A0))))
PSI = [F(0), F(3, 5), F(4, 5), F(0)]
UP = [F(0), F(4), F(-3), F(0)]


def check_v_is_the_particle_hole_automorphism():
    ok = V == tr(V) and mm(V, V) == ident()
    ok = ok and mm(mm(V, A0), V) == A0 and mm(mm(V, C0), V) == C0
    ok = ok and mm(mm(V, A1), V) == C1 and mm(mm(V, C1), V) == A1
    # the Majorana factor alone flips the sign of a0; Gamma_0 restores it
    M = madd(A1, C1)
    ok = ok and mm(mm(M, A0), M) == msc(-1, A0)
    _tp_rv = (ok); assert _tp_rv is not False, "check_v_is_the_particle_hole_automorphism"; return _tp_rv


def check_image_state_and_pairing_generator():
    premise("angle.hop-across-cut")
    ok = True
    vpsi = mv(V, PSI)
    ok = ok and vpsi == [F(4, 5), F(0), F(0), F(3, 5)]
    gam = mm(G0, madd(ident(), msc(-2, N1)))
    ok = ok and mv(gam, vpsi) == vpsi                       # even
    n0 = sum(vpsi[i] * mv(N0, vpsi)[i] for i in range(DIM))
    ok = ok and (1 - n0, n0) == (F(16, 25), F(9, 25))
    # conjugated generator against the pairing generator, entry by entry
    pair = madd(msc(7, N0), msc(-12, madd(mm(C0, C1), mm(A1, A0))))
    VHV = mm(mm(V, H), V)
    ok = ok and VHV == pair
    # spectrum carried over: eigenvalues 0, 7, 16, -9 on the image eigenbasis
    basis = [[F(1), F(0), F(0), F(0)], [F(0), F(0), F(0), F(1)], UP, PSI]
    vals = [F(0), F(7), F(16), F(-9)]
    for b, lam in zip(basis, vals):
        ok = ok and mv(H, b) == [lam * x for x in b]
        vb = mv(V, b)
        ok = ok and mv(pair, vb) == [lam * x for x in vb]
    ok = ok and GA.field_rank([mv(V, b) for b in basis]) == 4
    ok = ok and min(vals[:3]) > vals[3]
    _tp_rv = (ok); assert _tp_rv is not False, "check_image_state_and_pairing_generator"; return _tp_rv


def check_equal_frequency_boost_becomes_number_difference():
    lhs = mm(mm(V, madd(N0, N1, msc(-1, ident()))), V)
    _tp_rv = (lhs == madd(N0, msc(-1, N1))); assert _tp_rv is not False, "check_equal_frequency_boost_becomes_number_difference"; return _tp_rv
angle.imported-conformal-model-null-rota:
"""angle.imported-conformal-model-null-rotations: exact checks (GA blade engine).

(1) Conformal model, for (p, q) in (1,3), (3,1), (2,0), (0,2), (2,2), (1,1): in Cl(p+1, q+1) with e+ (square +1)
    and e- (square -1) appended, nO = (e- - e+)/2 and nInf = e- + e+ are null with nO . nInf = -1;
    X(x) = nO + x + Q(x) nInf / 2 is null and X(x) . X(y) = -Q(x - y)/2 for every pair of sample points x, y
    (Q(x) = x^2).
(2) Null rotations: for a null v with a partner w (v . w != 0) and U = {v, w}^perp, namely
    (v, w, U) = (nInf, nO, base vectors) in Cl(2,4), Cl(3,1) and Cl(2,2), and (e0 + e1, (e0 - e1)/4, span(e2, e3))
    inside Cl(1,3): R_u = 1 + v u is even with R_u reverse(R_u) = 1, fixes v, maps every basis vector to a
    vector, R_u R_u' = R_(u + u') on sample pairs, and u -> v u is injective on U (rank dim U), so u -> R_u
    is an isomorphism of (U, +) onto N_v = {R_u}. Control: u = v (outside U) gives R = 1.
"""
from fractions import Fraction as F

import GA
from tp_premise import premise

SIGS = [(1, 3), (3, 1), (2, 0), (0, 2), (2, 2), (1, 1)]
COEFFS = [(F(1), F(-2), F(1, 3), F(0)), (F(3, 4), F(0), F(-1), F(5)), (F(-2), F(1, 2), F(2), F(-1, 7))]
UCOEFFS = [(F(1), F(2, 3), F(-1), F(4)), (F(-3), F(1, 5), F(0), F(2))]


def vecs(n, coeffs):
    return [{(i,): c for i, c in enumerate(cs[:n]) if c != 0} for cs in coeffs]


def dot(x, y, sq):
    z = GA.add(GA.mul(x, y, sq), GA.mul(y, x, sq))
    return z.get((), F(0)) * F(1, 2)


def conformal(p, q):
    n = p + q
    sq = GA.sig(p, q) + (1, -1)
    ep, em = GA.gen(n), GA.gen(n + 1)
    nO = GA.scal(F(1, 2), GA.sub(em, ep))
    nI = GA.add(em, ep)
    return n, sq, nO, nI


def X(x, nO, nI, sq):
    Q = GA.mul(x, x, sq).get((), F(0))
    return GA.add(nO, x, GA.scal(Q * F(1, 2), nI))


def check_conformal_model():
    premise("transport.totality")
    ok = True
    for p, q in SIGS:
        n, sq, nO, nI = conformal(p, q)
        ok = ok and GA.mul(nO, nO, sq) == {} and GA.mul(nI, nI, sq) == {}
        ok = ok and dot(nO, nI, sq) == -1
        pts = vecs(n, COEFFS)
        for x in pts:
            ok = ok and GA.mul(X(x, nO, nI, sq), X(x, nO, nI, sq), sq) == {}
            for y in pts:
                d = GA.sub(x, y)
                Qd = GA.mul(d, d, sq).get((), F(0))
                ok = ok and dot(X(x, nO, nI, sq), X(y, nO, nI, sq), sq) == -Qd * F(1, 2)
    GA.check("conformal model: null pair with nO . nInf = -1, X(x) null, X(x) . X(y) = -Q(x - y)/2", ok)
    return ok


def null_rotation_cases():
    out = []
    for p, q in [(1, 3), (2, 0), (1, 1)]:
        n, sq, nO, nI = conformal(p, q)
        out.append((sq, nI, nO, [GA.gen(i) for i in range(n)], n + 2))
    sq = GA.sig(1, 3)
    v = GA.add(GA.gen(0), GA.gen(1))
    w = GA.scal(F(1, 4), GA.sub(GA.gen(0), GA.gen(1)))
    out.append((sq, v, w, [GA.gen(2), GA.gen(3)], 4))
    return out


def check_null_rotations_isomorphic_to_u():
    premise("transport.group-null-rotations")
    ok = True
    for sq, v, w, Ubasis, m_ in null_rotation_cases():
        ok = ok and GA.mul(v, v, sq) == {} and dot(v, w, sq) != 0
        ok = ok and all(dot(u, v, sq) == 0 and dot(u, w, sq) == 0 for u in Ubasis)
        us = []
        for cs in UCOEFFS:
            u = {}
            for c, b in zip(cs, Ubasis):
                u = GA.add(u, GA.scal(c, b))
            us.append(u)
        for u in us:
            R = GA.add(GA.sc(1), GA.mul(v, u, sq))
            ok = ok and all(len(b) % 2 == 0 for b in R)
            ok = ok and GA.mul(R, GA.reverse(R), sq) == GA.sc(1)
            Rinv = GA.reverse(R)
            ok = ok and GA.mul(GA.mul(R, v, sq), Rinv, sq) == v
            ok = ok and all(all(len(b) == 1 for b in GA.mul(GA.mul(R, GA.gen(i), sq), Rinv, sq)) for i in range(m_))
        for u in us:
            for u2 in us:
                lhs = GA.mul(GA.add(GA.sc(1), GA.mul(v, u, sq)), GA.add(GA.sc(1), GA.mul(v, u2, sq)), sq)
                ok = ok and lhs == GA.add(GA.sc(1), GA.mul(v, GA.add(u, u2), sq))
        rows = [GA.basis_vector_of(GA.mul(v, u, sq), GA.all_blades(m_)) for u in Ubasis]
        ok = ok and GA.rank_of_vectors(rows) == len(Ubasis)
        ok = ok and GA.add(GA.sc(1), GA.mul(v, v, sq)) == GA.sc(1)
    ok = ok and [len(c[3]) for c in null_rotation_cases()] == [4, 2, 2, 2]
    GA.check("R_u = 1 + v u: rotors fixing v, R_u R_u' = R_(u+u'), injective on U", ok)
    return ok
angle.imported-singularity-papers-state-:
"""angle.imported-singularity-papers-state-selection: exact checks of the finite cores of this imported Fact.

Horizon pair: two fermionic modes, Jordan-Wigner basis |n0 n1> (index n0 + 2 n1), boost K = w (N0 - N1) (the
number-difference boost of the vacuum form), sample w = 1.
(a) State form: the vectors invariant up to phase under e^{itK} are the eigenvectors of K; its eigenspaces are
    span{|00>, |11>} (0), |10> (w), |01> (-w), computed as kernels. Cyclic and separating for the mode-0 factor
    means Schmidt rank 2 (full-rank reduced density matrix): c|00> + s|11> has it iff c s != 0, and |10>, |01>
    and |00> do not.
(b) Marginal diag(c^2, s^2) = Gibbs diag(1, q)/(1 + q) with q = tan^2 theta = s^2/c^2; the sample point
    q = 9/16 is (c, s) = (4/5, 3/5).
(c) Automorphisms intertwining the flow act on beta through {+-1}: an inner automorphism Ad(U) of M_2 with
    U K U^{-1} = lambda K + mu has characteristic polynomial x^2 - w^2/4 = (x - mu)^2 - lambda^2 w^2/4, forcing
    mu = 0 and lambda^2 = 1; U = 1 and the particle-hole swap realise lambda = 1 and -1, and the linear system
    U K = (lambda K + mu) U has only the zero solution for lambda in {2, 1/2, -3} (any mu tested at the forced
    value 0 and at sample values).
(d) Schwarzschild f(r) = 1 - 2M/r: horizon r = 2M, kappa = f'(r_h)/2 = 1/(4M); near the horizon f = 2 kappa x
    - x^2/(4M^2) + O(x^3) in x = r - r_h, so the Euclidean section is smooth at period 2 pi/kappa = 8 pi M
    (coefficient of pi checked at several M).
(e) What imposing KMS mode by mode fixes: for one mode with Boltzmann ratio q = e^{-beta w}, the KMS relations
    phi(E_ab E_cd) = phi(E_cd alpha_{i beta}(E_ab)) on all matrix-unit pairs, solved for a general linear functional
    phi on M_2, have a one-dimensional solution space spanned by diag(1, q); normalised, the marginal is the Gibbs
    state diag(1, q)/(1 + q), at q in {9/16, 1/3, 5}. That (R) imposes KMS, and at the period 2 pi/kappa, is the
    content of the assumed premise singularity.r-regularity-fixed-locus and is not computed here.
(f) Ultralocal supplied class: on three modes every number monomial prod_{x in S} N_x (S any subset) and every
    parity section 1 - 2 N_x commutes with every N_x, while the hopping generator a_0^dag a_1 (outside the class)
    does not.
(g) Sea-level occupancies of the s-wave array: with the weights w_k = kappa k entered as premise (Q)'s convention
    (not derived here), the occupancies n_k = 1/(x^{-k} + 1), x = e^{-beta kappa}, have n_0 = 1/2 and
    n_k + n_{-k} = 1 (explicit values at x = 1/2), and the bilinear weights, computed as the eigenvalues of
    [H, a_j^dag a_i] for H = sum_k kappa k N_k on the sites -1, 0, 1, depend only on the site difference.
"""
from fractions import Fraction as F
from itertools import product

import GA
from pyutil import get_or_set
import fock
from tp_premise import premise

DIM = 4
SAMPLE_CS = [(F(4, 5), F(3, 5)), (F(5, 13), F(-12, 13)), (F(1), F(0)), (F(0), F(1))]
MASSES = [F(1, 2), F(3), F(7, 4)]
QS = [F(9, 16), F(1, 3), F(5)]


def zero(n=DIM):
    return [[F(0)] * n for _ in range(n)]


mm = GA.mat_mul                         # dense matrix product


def madd(a, b, c=1):
    return [[a[i][j] + F(c) * b[i][j] for j in range(len(a))] for i in range(len(a))]


def ident(n=DIM):
    return [[F(1) if i == j else F(0) for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]


def num(k):
    return fock.to_dense(fock.num(k, 2), DIM)


def reduced(v):
    """Reduced density matrix on mode 0 of a real vector with even or odd parity (coefficients v[n0 + 2 n1])."""
    rho = zero(2)
    for a in range(2):
        for b in range(2):
            rho[a][b] = sum(v[a + 2 * n1] * v[b + 2 * n1] for n1 in range(2))
    return rho


def check_boost_invariant_cyclic_separating_states():
    premise("singularity.schmidt-forcing-proved-outright")
    K = madd(num(0), num(1), -1)
    ok = True
    dims = {}
    for lam in (F(0), F(1), F(-1), F(2)):
        ker = GA.field_kernel(madd(K, ident(), -lam))
        dims[lam] = len(ker)
    ok = ok and dims == {F(0): 2, F(1): 1, F(-1): 1, F(2): 0}
    full = 0
    for c, s in SAMPLE_CS:
        v = [c, F(0), F(0), s]
        ok = ok and [sum(K[i][j] * v[j] for j in range(DIM)) for i in range(DIM)] == [F(0)] * DIM
        rho = reduced(v)
        rank = GA.field_rank(rho)
        ok = ok and (rank == 2) == (c * s != 0)
        full += rank == 2
        if c * c + s * s == 1:
            ok = ok and rho == [[c * c, F(0)], [F(0), s * s]]
    for prod in ([F(0), F(1), F(0), F(0)], [F(0), F(0), F(1), F(0)]):
        ok = ok and GA.field_rank(reduced(prod)) == 1
    _tp_rv = (ok and full == 2); assert _tp_rv is not False, "check_boost_invariant_cyclic_separating_states"; return _tp_rv


def check_marginal_is_gibbs_at_the_sample_point():
    premise("singularity.modular-descent")
    c, s = F(4, 5), F(3, 5)
    q = s * s / (c * c)
    ok = q == F(9, 16) and c * c + s * s == 1
    ok = ok and (c * c, s * s) == (1 / (1 + q), q / (1 + q))
    _tp_rv = (ok); assert _tp_rv is not False, "check_marginal_is_gibbs_at_the_sample_point"; return _tp_rv


def check_intertwining_automorphisms_act_through_sign():
    premise("singularity.rate-rigidity-temperature-not-algebra-intrinsic")
    w = F(1)
    K = [[w / 2, F(0)], [F(0), -w / 2]]
    ok = True
    # characteristic polynomial coefficients: (trace, det) of K and of lambda K + mu
    for lam in (F(1), F(-1), F(2), F(1, 2), F(-3)):
        for mu in (F(0), F(1, 4), F(-1)):
            T = [[lam * K[0][0] + mu, F(0)], [F(0), lam * K[1][1] + mu]]
            same = (T[0][0] + T[1][1], T[0][0] * T[1][1]) == (K[0][0] + K[1][1], K[0][0] * K[1][1])
            ok = ok and same == (mu == 0 and lam * lam == 1)
            # solve U K = T U for U (4 unknowns): an invertible solution exists iff conjugate
            rows = []
            for i in range(2):
                for j in range(2):
                    row = [F(0)] * 4
                    for k in range(2):
                        row[2 * i + k] += K[k][j]          # (U K)_ij = sum_k U_ik K_kj
                        row[2 * k + j] -= T[i][k]          # (T U)_ij = sum_k T_ik U_kj
                    rows.append(row)
            sols = GA.field_kernel(rows)
            inv = any(u[0] * u[3] - u[1] * u[2] != 0 for u in sols) or (
                len(sols) == 2 and (sols[0][0] + sols[1][0]) * (sols[0][3] + sols[1][3])
                - (sols[0][1] + sols[1][1]) * (sols[0][2] + sols[1][2]) != 0)
            ok = ok and inv == same
    swap = [[F(0), F(1)], [F(1), F(0)]]
    ok = ok and mm(mm(swap, K), swap) == [[-w / 2, F(0)], [F(0), w / 2]]
    _tp_rv = (ok); assert _tp_rv is not False, "check_intertwining_automorphisms_act_through_sign"; return _tp_rv

    ok = True

        for x in (F(1, 100), F(-1, 300)):

def check_supplied_class_ultralocal_and_sea_level_occupancies():
    premise("singularity.l-boundary-mode-locality")
    premise("singularity.class-relative-no-go-no-supplied")
    premise("singularity.q-joint-quasi-freeness-s-wave")
    m = 3

angle.value-parameter-dynamics:
"""angle.value-parameter-dynamics: exact checks.

Two fermionic modes in the Jordan-Wigner basis |n0 n1> (index n0 + 2 n1), H = eps N0 - t (a0^dag a1 + a1^dag a0).
(1) At the seven sample points of the proof, (c, s) = (3/5, 4/5), (5/13, 12/13), (8/17, 15/17), (7/25, 24/25),
    (24/25, 7/25), (-3/5, -4/5) at t = 60 and (3/5, -4/5) at t = -60: eps = t (s^2 - c^2)/(c s) against
    hand-tabulated values, c|10> + s|01> an eigenvector with eigenvalue -t c/s (tabulated), the other
    eigenvalues 0, eps and t s/c above it with the three gaps t s/c + t c/s, t c/s, t s/c positive, the four
    eigenvectors a basis (so the ground state is unique), and the left marginal diag(s^2, c^2), Gibbs for N0 at
    q = c^2/s^2 (tabulated).
(2) The gap identities as polynomial identities: on a grid of (c, s, t) the gaps equal t(c^2 + s^2)/(c s),
    t c/s, t s/c, so all are positive exactly when t c s > 0 (sign table on the grid).
(3) The determination clause, in its corrected form: with r = c/s, eps/t = 1/r - r, so r is a root of
    r^2 + (eps/t) r - 1 = 0, whose roots have product -1; the root is the one with the sign of t (t c s > 0), and
    q = r^2. Hence q is fixed by eps/t together with the sign of t, but not by eps/t alone: (c, s) = (4/5, 3/5)
    at t = 60 and (3/5, -4/5) at t = -60 share eps/t = -7/12 and have q = 16/9 and 9/16. (Reported: the formal
    statement's last sentence and the proof's "positive root" hold for t > 0 only.)
"""
from fractions import Fraction as F

import GA
import fock

DIM = 4
POINTS = [((3, 5), (4, 5), 60), ((5, 13), (12, 13), 60), ((8, 17), (15, 17), 60), ((7, 25), (24, 25), 60),
          ((24, 25), (7, 25), 60), ((-3, 5), (-4, 5), 60), ((3, 5), (-4, 5), -60)]
GRID_CS = [(F(3, 5), F(4, 5)), (F(-5, 13), F(12, 13)), (F(8, 17), F(-15, 17)), (F(-7, 25), F(-24, 25))]
GRID_T = [F(60), F(-2), F(1, 3), F(-7, 4)]


def zero():
    return [[F(0)] * DIM for _ in range(DIM)]


mm = GA.mat_mul                         # dense matrix product


def madd(*ms):
    return [[sum(m[i][j] for m in ms) for j in range(DIM)] for i in range(DIM)]


def msc(c, a):
    return [[F(c) * a[i][j] for j in range(DIM)] for i in range(DIM)]


def tr(a):
    return [[a[j][i] for j in range(DIM)] for i in range(DIM)]


def mv(a, v):
    return [sum(a[i][k] * v[k] for k in range(DIM)) for i in range(DIM)]


def ann(j):
    """a_j in the Jordan-Wigner basis (index n0 + 2 n1), dense: lib/fock.py in LSB order."""
    return fock.to_dense(fock.ann(j, 2), DIM)


A0, A1 = ann(0), ann(1)
C0, C1 = tr(A0), tr(A1)
N0 = mm(C0, A0)
HOP = madd(mm(C0, A1), mm(C1, A0))


def ham(eps, t):
    return madd(msc(eps, N0), msc(-t, HOP))


def check_ground_state_eigenvalue_and_marginal():
    expected = [(F(35), F(-45), F(9, 16)), (F(119), F(-25), F(25, 144)), (F(161, 2), F(-32), F(64, 225)),
                (F(2635, 14), F(-35, 2), F(49, 576)), (F(-2635, 14), F(-1440, 7), F(576, 49)),
                (F(35), F(-45), F(9, 16)), (F(35), F(-45), F(9, 16))]
    ok = len(expected) == len(POINTS)
    for (cc, ss, tt), (eps_x, lam_x, q_x) in zip(POINTS, expected):
        c, s, t = F(*cc), F(*ss), F(tt)
        ok = ok and c * c + s * s == 1 and t * c * s > 0
        eps = t * (s * s - c * c) / (c * s)
        ok = ok and eps == eps_x
        H = ham(eps, t)
        psi = [F(0), c, s, F(0)]
        lam = -t * c / s
        ok = ok and lam == lam_x and mv(H, psi) == [lam * x for x in psi]
        other = [F(0), s, -c, F(0)]
        top = t * s / c
        ok = ok and mv(H, other) == [top * x for x in other]
        vac, both = [F(1), F(0), F(0), F(0)], [F(0), F(0), F(0), F(1)]
        ok = ok and mv(H, vac) == [F(0)] * DIM and mv(H, both) == [eps * x for x in both]
        ok = ok and GA.field_rank([vac, both, psi, other]) == 4
        ok = ok and top - lam > 0 and 0 - lam > 0 and eps - lam > 0
        n0 = sum(psi[i] * mv(N0, psi)[i] for i in range(DIM))
        ok = ok and (1 - n0, n0) == (s * s, c * c) and n0 / (1 - n0) == q_x
    _tp_rv = (ok); assert _tp_rv is not False, "check_ground_state_eigenvalue_and_marginal"; return _tp_rv


def check_gap_identities_and_sign_condition():
    ok = True
    positive = 0
    for c, s in GRID_CS:
        for t in GRID_T:
            eps = t * (s * s - c * c) / (c * s)
            lam = -t * c / s
            gaps = (eps - lam - lam, 0 - lam, eps - lam)            # other eigenvalue is eps - lam
            ok = ok and gaps == (t * (c * c + s * s) / (c * s), t * c / s, t * s / c)
            allpos = all(g > 0 for g in gaps)
            ok = ok and allpos == (t * c * s > 0)
            positive += allpos
    _tp_rv = (ok and positive == 8); assert _tp_rv is not False, "check_gap_identities_and_sign_condition"; return _tp_rv


def check_gibbs_parameter_fixed_by_ratio_and_sign_of_t():
    ok = True
    for (cc, ss, tt) in POINTS:
        c, s, t = F(*cc), F(*ss), F(tt)
        ratio = (s * s - c * c) / (c * s)
        r = c / s
        ok = ok and r * r + ratio * r - 1 == 0
        # the other root is -1/r: product of the roots is -1, so exactly one has the sign of t
        r2 = -1 / r
        ok = ok and r2 * r2 + ratio * r2 - 1 == 0 and r * r2 == -1
        ok = ok and (r > 0) == (t > 0) and (r2 > 0) != (t > 0)
    # counterexample to "fixed by eps/t alone": same ratio, opposite signs of t, different q
    c1, s1, t1 = F(4, 5), F(3, 5), F(60)
    c2, s2, t2 = F(3, 5), F(-4, 5), F(-60)
    e1 = t1 * (s1 * s1 - c1 * c1) / (c1 * s1)
    e2 = t2 * (s2 * s2 - c2 * c2) / (c2 * s2)
    ok = ok and e1 / t1 == e2 / t2 == F(-7, 12)
    ok = ok and (c1 / s1) ** 2 == F(16, 9) and (c2 / s2) ** 2 == F(9, 16)
    ok = ok and (e1, e2) == (F(-35), F(35))
    _tp_rv = (ok); assert _tp_rv is not False, "check_gibbs_parameter_fixed_by_ratio_and_sign_of_t"; return _tp_rv

from fractions import Fraction as F

def vec(c):

def cmul(x, y, sq):
    (a, b), (c, d) = x, y
    return (GA.sub(GA.mul(a, c, sq), GA.mul(b, d, sq)), GA.add(GA.mul(a, d, sq), GA.mul(b, c, sq)))

def check_null_rotations_translate_points_in_the_completion():

from itertools import combinations

import GA
import fock
from tp_premise import premise

# sample supplied generators: {subset of modes: coefficient}
GENS2 = [{(0,): 3, (1,): 5, (0, 1): -9}, {(0,): -2, (1,): 1, (0, 1): 4}, {(0,): 2, (1,): 2, (0, 1): -4}]
GENS3 = [{(0,): 2, (1,): -3, (2,): 1, (0, 2): 4, (0, 1, 2): -1},
         {(0,): 1, (1,): 1, (2,): 1, (0, 1): -1, (1, 2): -1}, {(1,): -4, (0, 1): 3, (2,): 2}]
WEIGHTS = [F(1), F(3, 2), F(-2, 5)]


def number_op(nu, k):
    return fock.to_dense(fock.num(k, nu), 1 << nu)


mm = GA.mat_mul                         # dense matrix product


def madd(a, b, c=1):
    n = len(a)
    return [[a[i][j] + F(c) * b[i][j] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]


def build(nu, poly):
    d = 1 << nu
    H = [[F(0)] * d for _ in range(d)]
    for S, coef in poly.items():
        P = [[F(1) if i == j else F(0) for j in range(d)] for i in range(d)]
        for k in S:
            P = mm(P, number_op(nu, k))
        H = madd(H, P, coef)
    return H


def mv(a, v):
    return [sum(a[i][k] * v[k] for k in range(len(v))) for i in range(len(a))]


def expect(v, op):
    w = mv(op, v)
    return sum(v[i] * w[i] for i in range(len(v)))


def check_unique_ground_state_is_a_product_number_state():
    premise("singularity.class-relative-no-go-no-supplied")
    ok = True
    unique = 0
    for nu, gens in ((2, GENS2), (3, GENS3)):
        d = 1 << nu
        Ns = [number_op(nu, k) for k in range(nu)]
        for poly in gens:
            H = build(nu, poly)
            ok = ok and all(H[i][j] == 0 for i in range(d) for j in range(d) if i != j)
            diag = [H[i][i] for i in range(d)]
            low = min(diag)
            if diag.count(low) != 1:
                continue
            unique += 1
            g = diag.index(low)
            v = [F(1) if i == g else F(0) for i in range(d)]
            ok = ok and mv(H, v) == [low * x for x in v]
            # eigenvector of every N_k and of the boost generators
            for k in range(nu):
                nk = expect(v, Ns[k])
                ok = ok and mv(Ns[k], v) == [nk * x for x in v] and nk in (0, 1)
                # single-mode marginal diag(1 - nk, nk): a rank-one idempotent
                m = (1 - nk, nk)
                ok = ok and m[0] * m[1] == 0 and m[0] + m[1] == 1
                # Gibbs diag(1, q)/(1 + q) at no finite beta: q/(1+q) = nk needs q = 0 or has no solution
                if nk == 0:
                    ok = ok and all(qq / (1 + qq) != 0 for qq in (F(1, 9), F(1), F(7)))
                else:
                    ok = ok and all(1 / (1 + qq) != 0 for qq in (F(1, 9), F(1), F(7)))
            K = [[F(0)] * d for _ in range(d)]
            for k in range(nu):
                K = madd(K, madd(Ns[k], [[F(1, 2) if i == j else F(0) for j in range(d)] for i in range(d)], -1),
                         WEIGHTS[k])
            kv = expect(v, K)
            ok = ok and mv(K, v) == [kv * x for x in v]
            # product across every cut: number projectors factorise
            for size in range(1, nu):
                for left in combinations(range(nu), size):
                    right = [k for k in range(nu) if k not in left]
                    PL = build(nu, {tuple(left): 1})
                    PR = build(nu, {tuple(right): 1})
                    ok = ok and expect(v, mm(PL, PR)) == expect(v, PL) * expect(v, PR)
    _tp_rv = (ok and unique == 5); assert _tp_rv is not False, "check_unique_ground_state_is_a_product_number_state"; return _tp_rv


def check_degenerate_ground_space_selects_nothing():
    H = build(2, {(0,): 1, (1,): 1, (0, 1): -2})
    ok = [H[i][i] for i in range(4)] == [F(0), F(1), F(1), F(0)]       # |00>, |10>, |01>, |11>
    ker = GA.field_kernel(H)
    ok = ok and len(ker) == 2
    tfd = [F(4, 5), F(0), F(0), F(3, 5)]
    prod = [F(1), F(0), F(0), F(0)]
    ok = ok and mv(H, tfd) == [F(0)] * 4 and mv(H, prod) == [F(0)] * 4
    ok = ok and GA.field_rank(ker + [tfd]) == 2 and GA.field_rank(ker + [prod]) == 2
    n0 = expect(tfd, number_op(2, 0))
    ok = ok and (1 - n0, n0) == (F(16, 25), F(9, 25)) and expect(prod, number_op(2, 0)) == 0
    _tp_rv = (ok); assert _tp_rv is not False, "check_degenerate_ground_space_selects_nothing"; return _tp_rv
